meta.title: REA reverse-engineering tools (dsh-rea)
meta.description: Mounts the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server as the `rea` tool namespace: 255 analysis tools for binaries, firmware, Electron/JavaScript, browsers and managed runtimes. Their schemas cost roughly 200K tokens of context in every request, so keep this off outside reverse-engineering sessions. One switch turns it on, and npx fetches the newest rea-agents release.
